subject: Request: isolation support credit and temporary SLA waiver for FortifyHealth VPC pilot
messages:
From: Sophia Park <sophia.park@fortifyhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Requesting isolation support credits + temporary SLA waiver for VPC pilot

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — team is excited to move into a short private VPC pilot. Before we start, security raised a few gating items that impact our runway and cost assumptions. To keep the pilot viable we are requesting: a) a modest credit allotment to cover dedicated nodes for ~2 weeks (~750 GPU hours), and b) a temporary SLA waiver on the 99th percentile latency SLO while we validate connectivity and KMS integration.

What Security needs from our side: the completed questionnaire (attached), network diagram, and confirmation on KMS/bring-your-own-key options. We attached the security questionnaire and our internal network diagram.

Timeline: we’d like to spin up the pilot the week of Jan 4, 2027 and run 2–3 weeks. Can Redwood provide a capped credit (amount / hours) and a short-term SLA adjustment for the evaluation window? Procurement will need a one-page MOU if we proceed.

Attachments: security-questionnaire_fortify_v2.pdf (pdf), network-diagram.png (png)

Best,
Sophia

Hi Sophia — thanks for the clear ask and attachments. We can definitely collaborate on this. Quick outline of what we need internally to approve credit + SLA exception:

- Exact credit ask (dollars / GPU hours) and the pilot window (start/end dates)
- Minimal data classification for the pilot (PHI/PII or none) — helps us scope retention
- Confirmation on KMS: will you bring your own key (BYOK) or use Redwood-managed keys?
- Any special networking constraints (eg. customer firewall rules, peering schedule) beyond the diagram

Marcus — can you run a risk + credit cap recommendation (rough upper bound) assuming BYOK? Karthik — can you confirm which evidence from the questionnaire is sufficient for a short, timeboxed approval and what we must require in the MOU? Laura — I’ll need a rough commercial proposal for credits so procurement has a number to review.

I’ll coordinate a single one-pager MOU draft after we confirm the items above.

Thanks,
Irene

Subject: Re: Requesting isolation support credits + temporary SLA waiver for VPC pilot

Irene — tagging in my assessment.

Summary: FortifyHealth looks low-risk for a timeboxed pilot provided we get BYOK or a customer-managed KMS key and limit retention to 72 hours for inference logs. Recommended approval: credit cap equivalent to $10,000 (approx ~650 GPU hours on Dedicated nodes) with automatic expiration at the end of the pilot window. Approve temporary SLA adjustment to target p99 latency of 700ms (versus our usual 300ms) for the duration of the pilot; this is only for the FortifyHealth VPC environment and reverts after the pilot ends.

Controls required before spin-up:
- KMS configured and key policy vetted (rotate every 90 days)
- Access to SOC2 extract for controls 7.1–7.4 (I attached the extract we maintain that maps to our infra controls).
- Network peering plan confirmed and a scheduled maintenance window for initial rollout.

Attachments: SOC2-extract-for-pilot.pdf, kpi-runbook.md

If the customer agrees to the 72-hour retention and BYOK, I’m comfortable with the credit/sla proposal above.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Risk & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 14:55:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Requesting isolation support credits + temporary SLA waiver for VPC pilot

Folks — read through FortifyHealth questionnaire and the SOC2 extract Marcus shared. A few notes and redlines we should include in the MOU:

- Evidence: SOC2 extract is acceptable for pilot; however we must obtain a signed attestation from the customer security team that no regulated PHI will be ingested. If PHI may be present, we escalate to legal and require an addendum.
- Pen test: ask for the most recent external penetration test summary (one page) or acceptance of Redwood’s in-scope pen test clarifications.
- Retention: enforce 72-hour retention on inference logs and any customer-provided dataset. No snapshots beyond that period.
- KMS: prefer BYOK, but if they choose Redwood-managed keys, require an IP allowlist and limited session tokens for the pilot team.

If we add those as conditions and include the credit cap Marcus proposed, I can sign off on security for the pilot. Suggest we add an explicit escape clause: Redwood can terminate the pilot if an elevated finding emerges.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security & Privacy Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Approval: FortifyHealth isolated pilot — credit allocation and temporary SLA terms (MOU next steps)

Hi Sophia / Procurement team — thank you for the packet and patience while we completed internal review. Based on the controls you supplied and the security questionnaire, Redwood is prepared to approve a timeboxed pilot under the following conditions:

1) Approved credits: $10,000 in platform credits to be applied to the FortifyHealth VPC pilot environment. Credit expires automatically at the end of the pilot (three weeks maximum unless otherwise agreed).
2) SLA waiver: temporary p99 latency target increased to 700ms for the VPC pilot window only (Jan 4–Jan 25, 2027). Redwood will revert to standard SLOs after the pilot.
3) Security conditions: BYOK strongly preferred. If FortifyHealth cannot BYOK, Redwood-managed keys are acceptable with IP allowlist and limited admin sessions. Inference logs retained for a maximum of 72 hours; no snapshots or exports beyond that window.
4) Evidence: please provide a one-page pen-test summary or acceptance of our in-scope pen test. Procurement should sign the one-page MOU and the attached pilot-MOU-draft.docx.

Next steps:
- I’ve attached the MOU draft for procurement to review. (pilot-MOU-draft.docx)
- Laura will follow up with a formal credit memo and HubSpot deal update.
- Marcus & Karthik will perform a quick BYOK onboarding checklist prior to spin-up.
- Sophia, please confirm acceptance of the retention and KMS approach and upload the pen-test summary to the HubSpot deal.
